OSTC4 exposure checkpoint v1 — experimental PC continuity evidence
================================================================

Public boundary: ostc4_exposure_checkpoint / ostc4_exposure_restore in
include/ostc4_exposure.h. The caller owns all storage, clocks and the evidence
that supplied pressure segments really cover exposure. This code accesses
neither files nor RTC/flash. ostc4_exposure_initialize explicitly starts a fresh
SYNTHETIC fixture; recovery never uses fresh equilibrium as missing exposure.

Format: exactly 293 bytes; unsigned little-endian integers, IEEE binary32 float
bits, no native padding or upstream structs. Offsets (bytes):
  0  magic EXC1 (4)
  4  schema version 1 (u32)
  8  numerical-policy fingerprint (u32)
 12  total length 293 (u32)
 16  timestamp seconds (u32)
 20  accumulated dive/transition seconds (u32)
 24  surface pressure bar (f32)
 28  ambient pressure bar (f32)
 32  maximum depth metres (f32)
 36  persistent GF anchor ambient bar (f32)
 40  persistent GF-low depth bar (f32)
 44  current calculated ceiling metres (f32)
 48  nitrogen tissues, 16*f32
112  helium tissues, 16*f32 (zero in this air-only policy)
176  last NDL seconds (u32)
180  last TTS seconds (u32)
184  mandatory stop seconds, 50*u16
284  tissues, NDL, TTS, ceiling, stops availability (5*u8)
289  CRC-32/ISO-HDLC of bytes [0,289), polynomial 0xedb88320 reflected,
     init/xorout 0xffffffff (u32); matches Python zlib.crc32.

The policy fingerprint uses the same CRC over the newline-separated revision,
OSTC4_POLICY, correction set, continuous-exposure policy and literal
ieee-binary32-binary64-no-fast-math-no-contract-checkpoint-v1, without final NUL.
These identifiers MUST change whenever numerical/settings semantics change.
CRC and fingerprint detect accidental corruption/compatibility mismatch; neither
provides cryptographic authenticity. Schema v1 is new OSTC4-specific work and
inherits no independent BMAD engine checkpoint layout.

Persistent state audit: initialize reconstructs fixed air/GF/ascent/stop settings,
then recovery replaces all persisted tissue/time/pressure/max-depth/anchor state
before allowing an exposure calculation. Cached current results/availability
support immediate read at an unchanged checkpoint timestamp without running a
planner that could mutate the anchor. They are retained for that reason.
In pinned buehlmann_calc_deco, surface, pressure, gas id, tissues, GF and CNS
are assigned each call. Backup scratch is written before read; stop scratch is
assigned before use. Ceiling follows that call. Only gGF_low_depth_bar carries
planner state across accepted samples; it is persisted with the settings anchor.
Prediction still snapshots/restores all mutable scratch. No raw SLifeData,
SDiveSettings or scratch-struct binary layout is a persistence contract.

Recovery contract
-----------------
A known restart timestamp in the checkpoint's monotonic seconds domain and a
caller-declared maximum checkpoint age are mandatory. Age is a freshness gate,
not evidence of the pressure that occurred. Backward/unknown time is rejected.
The maximum age is caller policy (bench: 86400 seconds); zero permits only a
same-timestamp restore. Timestamp wrap is not inferred.

For positive elapsed time, history must supply every complete linear segment
starting at the checkpoint's pressure/time, with increasing times <=3600 seconds
apart, ending EXACTLY at restart time. Supplied segments are assertions of known
exposure, not sparse measurements that magically fill an unobserved gap.
Use the same sample cadence as the uninterrupted control: planner anchors and
binary32 rounding may depend on segmentation. A surface-only history is accepted
only when that pressure exposure is explicitly established by the caller.
At exactly the saved timestamp, known time plus an empty history asserts zero
elapsed exposure. An old checkpoint and elapsed time alone never suffice.

Integrity, schema/policy, numerical bounds, age, clock and coverage failures each
return a named status and latch all observable validity fields INVALID. This is
also true in a fresh process. Advance/predict/save cannot clear that condition.
A later complete proven recovery or deliberate synthetic initialize is required.
No healthy state is saved from an invalid scenario. Output bytes are unchanged
when checkpoint creation fails. All operations remain serialized, like the engine.

OSTC4 experimental unchanged PC baseline (ticket 01)
=================================================
One standalone portable-C calculation adapter and a headless replay tool.
No integration with Zephyr, LVGL, watch drivers or scripted demonstrations.

From the repository root:
  cmake -S V2/Firmware/ostc4_baseline -B /tmp/ostc4-baseline-build \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
  cmake --build /tmp/ostc4-baseline-build -j
  ctest --test-dir /tmp/ostc4-baseline-build --output-on-failure
  /tmp/ostc4-baseline-build/ostc4_replay \
    V2/Firmware/ostc4_baseline/fixtures/shallow.csv
  python3 V2/Firmware/ostc4_baseline/record_evidence.py \
    /tmp/ostc4-baseline-build /tmp/ostc4-observations

Build dependencies: C11 compiler (tested GCC on Linux), CMake, libm and an
ELF linker supporting function/data sections and --gc-sections. Python 3
standard library generates the corrected source copy and runs tests/evidence recording. No network
fetch is required. Upstream headers contain a zero-length array extension;
the original bytes are retained, so this build currently needs GCC/Clang.
The public header has no platform dependency. Test assertions remain active
in Release builds. Adapter/replay code compiles with warnings as errors.

Source and notices:
  upstream/                 11 exact original files; do not edit
  upstream-manifest.json    exact revision, selected file hashes, archive hashes
  COPYING.html              GPLv3 text retained from the completed reuse audit
  compat/                   declaration-only RTC types; no HAL implementation
  include/, src/            new public interface and adapter/CLI, GPL-3.0-or-later
  fixtures/                 timestamped synthetic inputs (not dive schedules)
  policy.json               declared extraction policy and original coefficient table
  evidence/                 baseline observations and actual compiler/link inputs

The two original translation units are compiled unchanged. Their original
headers are private dependencies of the calculation adapter. The linker
removes unrelated helpers (including the gas-list helper referencing calc_MOD).
No fake calc_MOD, hardware, settings-service or clock implementation is supplied.
The retained original firmwareEraseProgram.h is a declaration-only include
needed by settings.h; no flash management code is compiled or linked.

Upstream GPL-3.0-or-later notices are preserved verbatim in the selected files.
buehlmann.c itself has no full license notice; its companion buehlmann.h does.
Compatibility shims, adapter, replay and support scripts added for this ticket
are GPL-3.0-or-later. Manufacturer provenance and distribution adoption remain
separate gates; this fork beta is not identified as a stable manufacturer build.

Public input/output contract:
  ostc4_initialize explicitly starts one fresh synthetic surface-equilibrium
  scenario. It is never an automatic history/restart recovery action.
  ostc4_advance consumes a timestamp and absolute bar. Linear interpolation
  between pressures is declared input behavior, not inferred sensor exposure.
  Equal pressures use original cached exposure factors, including known defects.
  ostc4_read copies the most recent accepted observation, without calculation.
  There is one active scenario and calls must be serialized. No thread safety,
  independent prediction API, checkpoint or repetitive-dive lifecycle is claimed.

CSV header is timestamp_seconds,absolute_pressure_bar. The first data row
explicitly declares initial timestamp and surface pressure (0.8..1.2 bar).
Later timestamps must be unsigned integral seconds, strictly increasing, no
more than 3600 s apart. No implicit subsecond rounding. Pressures must be
finite and between the declared surface and surface+6 bar. Bounds are this
experimental replay's supported input envelope, not a real diving limit.
There is no unknown-gap marker: every accepted interval declares a complete
linear segment; callers must not submit incomplete measured history as one.
Input errors reject the sample transactionally. A read after rejection still
returns the prior accepted timestamp; never treat it as a result for the bad
sample. The CLI exits nonzero on any rejection; preceding JSONL is incomplete.

All nitrogen/helium arrays, raw NDL/TTS seconds, raw ceiling metres, 50 raw
stop durations, anchor values and per-result availability are observable.
Stop index i corresponds to gauge depth (i+1)*3 m at the declared 0.1 bar/m.
The dive timer counts all intervals with either endpoint below surface,
excluding wholly surface intervals. Fresh reset sets the settings anchor and
upstream GF-low global to zero. Each accepted advance calls planner followed
by ceiling and retains upstream settings-anchor/global-GF changes. Read calls
cannot change those values. Prediction isolation is ticket 03 work.

Unavailable: before 60 accumulated underwater/transition seconds, at surface,
or ambiguous all-zero NDL/TTS output. Limited: NDL reaches 14400 s or TTS / a
stop reaches 59940 s; saturated TTS also makes ceiling/stops limited.

"""Apply the explicit correction set only to an exactly pinned build copy."""
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import sys

root, output = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
source = root / 'upstream/Common/Src/decom.c'
original = source.read_bytes()
manifest = json.loads((root / 'upstream-manifest.json').read_text())
if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != manifest['files']['Common/Src/decom.c']:
    raise SystemExit('refusing to patch changed upstream source')
corrections = json.loads((root / 'corrections/tissue-corrections.json').read_text())
patched = original
for correction in corrections['changes']:
    old, new = correction['original'].encode(), correction['corrected'].encode()
    if patched.count(old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit('correction literal must occur exactly once: ' + correction['original'])
    patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
block = corrections['schreiner']
old = (root / 'corrections' / block['original_file']).read_bytes()
new = (root / 'corrections' / block['corrected_file']).read_bytes()
if (hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest() != block['original_sha256'] or
        hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest() != block['corrected_sha256']):
    raise SystemExit('changed Schreiner correction definition')
# Match the original line endings; preserve every untouched source byte.
if b'\r\n' in original:
    old, new = old.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'), new.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')
if patched.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Schreiner correction must match exactly once')
patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_bytes(patched)

"""Generate containment accessors without changing planner arithmetic.
Pinned source remains unchanged. Lift the six backup statics to file scope so
both branches of backup/restore are captured along with every planner global.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
path = Path(sys.argv[1])
original = path.read_bytes()
manifest = json.loads((path.parents[3] / "upstream-manifest.json").read_text())
if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != manifest["files"]["Discovery/Src/buehlmann.c"]:
    raise SystemExit("refusing to contain changed upstream planner")
source = original.decode("latin1")
start = source.index("static void buehlmann_backup_and_restore(_Bool backup_restore_otherwise)\r\n{")
end = source.index("float buehlmann_get_gCNS", start)
body = source[start:end]
fields = [("pressure", "float", ""), ("gas_id", "float", ""),
          ("tissue_nitrogen_bar", "float", "[16]"), ("tissue_helium_bar", "float", "[16]"),
          ("gf_value", "float", ""), ("cns", "float", "")]
declarations = ""
for name, kind, array in fields:
    declaration = f"static {kind} {name}{array};"
    if body.count(declaration) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected backup storage: " + declaration)
    body = body.replace(declaration, "")
    body = re.sub(r"\b" + name + r"\b", "saved_" + name, body)
    declarations += f"static {kind} saved_{name}{array};\n"
source = source[:start] + declarations + body + source[end:]
pairs = [("surface", "gSurface_pressure_bar"), ("pressure", "gPressure"),
         ("nitrogen", "gTissue_nitrogen_bar"), ("helium", "gTissue_helium_bar"),
         ("gf", "gGF_value"), ("cns", "gCNS"), ("gf_depth", "gGF_low_depth_bar"),
         ("gas_id", "gGas_id"), ("stop_depth", "gStop.depth"), ("stop_id", "gStop.id"),
         ("backup_pressure", "saved_pressure"), ("backup_gas_id", "saved_gas_id"),
         ("backup_nitrogen", "saved_tissue_nitrogen_bar"),
         ("backup_helium", "saved_tissue_helium_bar"),
         ("backup_gf", "saved_gf_value"), ("backup_cns", "saved_cns")]
source += '\n#include "ostc4_scratch.h"\n'
for restore in (False, True):
    source += f"void ostc4_scratch_{'restore' if restore else 'save'}({'const ' if restore else ''}ostc4_scratch *s) {{\n"
    for field, name in pairs:
        a, b = (name, "s->"+field) if restore else ("s->"+field, name)
        source += f"    memcpy(&{a}, &{b}, sizeof({a}));\n"
    source += "}\n"
output = Path(sys.argv[2])
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_bytes(source.encode("latin1"))

# comparisons permit binary32 inputs/state and the original poorly conditioned
# Schreiner evaluation. Bound covers cancellation at reciprocal k up to ~55,000 s.
SINGLE_ABS_BAR = 1.e-4

HISTORY_ABS_BAR = 5.e-4
FACTOR_ABS_TOL = 1.e-10
COEFFICIENT_ABS_TOL = 1.e-7
K_ABS_TOL = 1.e-9


def exposure_factor(seconds, half_min):
    return -math.expm1(-math.log(2.) * seconds / (60. * half_min))


def segment(initial, start_bar, end_bar, seconds, half_min, fraction=.79):
    """Exact integral of dP/dt=k*(Pi(t)-P), stable for small k*t.
    q=1-exp(-x); ramp response=1-q/x (series avoids cancellation).
    Equivalent to Haldane (flat) and Schreiner (ramp); k is per second.
    """
    x = math.log(2.) * seconds / (60. * half_min)
    q = -math.expm1(-x)
    ramp = (x/2 - x*x/6 + x*x*x/24 - x**4/120 + x**5/720) if x < .001 else 1-q/x
    inspired_start = fraction*(start_bar-.0493)
    return initial + (inspired_start-initial)*q + fraction*(end_bar-start_bar)*ramp

    tissue = [.7902*(rows[0][1]-.0493)]*16
    result = [tissue[:]]
    for (t0,p0),(t1,p1) in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        tissue = [segment(v,p0,p1,t1-t0,h) for v,h in zip(tissue,N2_HALF_MIN)]
        result.append(tissue[:])
    return result
